title: Red Dust Road (Zimbabwe Family)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums prominent warm baritone storytelling 82bpm analog tape warm Shona heritage instrumental passages
lyrics:
[Instrumental Intro — mbira and hosho]

[Verse 1]
The red dust road runs seven kilometres from the house to the gate
Jeff has walked it every morning for forty years, never late
The ngoma starts before the sun, the hosho marks the pace
Every step a kind of prayer, every step a kind of grace

[Verse 2]
Jill's radio plays through the dairy wall
Old Zim chill from the nineties, barely heard at all
But the workers hum it anyway as the milk comes down
This is how a family built something, this is how a legacy sounds

[Chorus]
Red dust road
Red dust road
The mbira plays the morning in
Red dust road
Red dust road
The farm is where the story begins

[Bridge — instrumental mbira break]

[Verse 3]
The road is gone now — sold with the farm, repaved
But the red dust lives in Kerri's shoes she saved
In the memory of the four AM that Jill knows
In the way Jeff still rises early wherever he goes

[Verse 4]
In Australia now, the kids don't know the farm
But they know something in their grandmother's arms
A stillness and a certainty, an early-morning calm
Red dust road — it's in the blood, it's in the song

[Outro — mbira returning]
Red dust road
Red dust road
The mbira plays on
Red dust road
